title: Prototype: Accessible micro-interactions for metric-filter chips + timezone-aware numeric formatting
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design and prototype a11y-first micro-interactions for metric-filter chips used in compact dashboards and rollout inspectors, and align cost/daily-rollup numeric formatting with timezone and locale settings. Goals: 1) Make filter chips keyboard reachable, announce state changes reliably to screen-readers, and preserve focus order when chips collapse into an overflow menu; 2) Ensure numeric abbreviations and daily cost rollups respect the user's selected timezone and locale (e.g., day boundaries, currency rounding, thousands separators); 3) Maintain color contrast and reduced-motion affordances for microinteraction states (hover, pressed, selected, invalid filter).
comments: 2025-01-16 Maya Patel: Kickoff - scoped prototype: keyboard flows for chip group, aria attributes (role=tablist vs. listbox trade-off), live-region announcement drafts. Linked initial Figma frames.
2025-01-20 Jordan Lee: Engineering note - prefer aria-pressed on toggle chips to avoid additional roving tabindex logic; raised a11y vs semantic grouping decision for multi-select behavior.

2025-01-24 Rui Chen (Design Lead): Feedback - preserve explicit focus outline when using compact density. Suggested contrast delta for selected state from #0F172A to #0B1220 for AA compliance with token mapping.

2025-01-28 Samir Gupta (A11y Eng): Review - recommended using an offscreen live region to announce "chip removed" and "chips collapsed" events; flagged performance impact of announcing each chip on batch updates. Proposed debounce pattern.

2025-01-31 Jordan Lee: Implementation experiment - built keyboard-only demo: arrow navigation, space/enter toggles, escape collapses overflow. Created PR with unit tests for focus restoration behavior.

2025-02-04 Maya Patel: Localisation check - worked with i18n to verify numeric abbreviations: short scale (k/M) vs locale full words for fr-FR. Added timezone note: daily-rollup should use user's console timezone for day boundaries and labels.

2025-02-07 Rui Chen: Design review - accepted reduced-motion variations and contrast adjustments. Asked to add visual indicator when chips are auto-merged into overflow to aid discoverability for keyboard users.

2025-02-10 Samir Gupta: Accessibility QA - verified live region messages read by VoiceOver and NVDA for single-chip remove and bulk-update debounce; requested small copy tweak to live region text to avoid ambiguous 'updated' wording.
2025-02-10 Jordan Lee: Next steps - polish aria-label copy, land small CSS token change for focus ring, coordinate with ENG-38420 (chip performance optimization) for rollout gating.
2025-02-10 Maya Patel: Ready for product review and canary rollout tests on console-2025.02 once ENG signoff is complete.
